acceptance_scenarios.name: current ordinary EXE positive handoff
acceptance_scenarios.given: One selected ordinary EXE, explicit sources, already selected portable toolchain, no PCH/modules/HU/additional objects or launch; actual terminal producer succeeds under an accounted gateway and continuously binds final request/recipe/content and a single-link local NTFS object.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Next implementation must allow the real A1/A2/A4 non-destructive transfer and close new admissions. Only after A3/A5 qualification may matching preview and single-use consent request disposition on that held EXE. Verified close/postcondition supports closed_name_absent; retain all other roles. No present execution success claimed.

acceptance_scenarios.name: no-op cannot mint a first receipt
acceptance_scenarios.given: Ordinary cache-hit/no-op result without a live current-session producer receipt.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Preserve normal build success/no-op; provide no new clean capability. Cache entry, existence or reused result cannot mint a first receipt.

acceptance_scenarios.name: producer errors and cache warnings
acceptance_scenarios.given: Compile/LINK failure, pending admitted cleanup/cache effects, or save_failed cache warning accompanying a successful build result.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Preserve original errors/warnings; failed or incomplete producer cannot transfer completion. A cache warning alone is not silently made a build failure or durable success: account for its actual effects and qualify the receipt separately.

acceptance_scenarios.name: proven missing exact output
acceptance_scenarios.given: Exact leaf absent under proven unchanged held parent; no case conflict, pending-deletion ambiguity or failed observation.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: already_absent, no delete request, no credited bytes. Missing inventory row or failed observation does not prove absence.

acceptance_scenarios.name: configuration architecture options overwrite
acceptance_scenarios.given: Debug receipt meets Release output, different architecture or ordered effective options at the same target path.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Refuse stale request. Same target/path cannot override effective request and producer mismatch.

acceptance_scenarios.name: stable metadata but changed content or inputs
acceptance_scenarios.given: File ID/size/mtime remain but content changes, or selected source/tool/input/effective-recipe bindings change after preview.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Invalidate the stale plan and retain. Accountable content/request checks are required; metadata and old signatures do not preserve consent.

acceptance_scenarios.name: wrong session epoch root or owner
acceptance_scenarios.given: Receipt reused after new process/session, changed epoch/root or owner abandonment.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Refuse stale authority. Live owning capabilities cannot be reconstructed from saved reports or markers.

acceptance_scenarios.name: consent selection and single use
acceptance_scenarios.given: Selection changes, execute is reused, or exported report/caller booleans are treated as authority.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Refuse invalid consent/capability; no selection expansion. Move/consume invalidates other uses; renewed preview needs a fresh explicit choice. Export only permitted non-sensitive identities or redacted descriptive summaries; raw sensitive values stay in memory and summaries cannot reconstruct authority.

acceptance_scenarios.name: EXE shared use and protected assets
acceptance_scenarios.given: Current EXE is another target/tool/generator input, retained dependency, released/protected asset or has unknown use coverage.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Veto and retain despite matching EXE kind, producer, content and identity. Unknown use coverage is not no consumers.

acceptance_scenarios.name: symbols and side outputs
acceptance_scenarios.given: PDB, ILK, MAP, manifests, DLL/import/export files adjacent to the EXE.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Retain all; distinguish compiler PDB, LINK PDB and unresolved ILK effects. Suffix and side-output membership grant no ownership or space permission.

acceptance_scenarios.name: shared intermediates caches inputs evidence
acceptance_scenarios.given: Object/PCH/IFC/HU/dependency state, all caches, source/config/generated inputs, tmp directories, logs/failure/release evidence.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Retain with no sibling or recursive deletion. Absence from one selected invocation is not obsolete status; another producer is outside this profile.

acceptance_scenarios.name: legacy path inventory and claims
acceptance_scenarios.given: Existing file has only inventory/association, candidate recipe, old record/generation, caller label, age or extension.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Unknown ownership; retain. Observation or empty gaps cannot replace producer/writer/use authority.

acceptance_scenarios.name: ambiguous path and namespace
acceptance_scenarios.given: NUL, parent traversal, drive/root-relative path, unknown relative cwd, ADS/device namespace or unsupported normalization.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Reject before mutation without guessed cwd, erased ambiguity or broad path fallback.

acceptance_scenarios.name: case aliases and conflicting claims
acceptance_scenarios.given: Case/lexical claims conflict or collapse distinct requested leaves.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Retain as ambiguous; case-folding is not physical identity or exact absence. Supported unambiguous spelling still needs all held-object bindings.

acceptance_scenarios.name: reparse or ancestor leaf replacement
acceptance_scenarios.given: Ancestor/leaf reparse, changed identity or junction/symlink retarget between production, preview and execute.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Refuse; keep continuous owning ancestors and leaf. Never follow replacement or delete by reopened path.

acceptance_scenarios.name: hard links and unknown count
acceptance_scenarios.given: Multiple hard links, unknown link count or duplicated physical-byte accounting by alias.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Refuse initial single-link profile. No alias unlink or duplicate byte credit; removed name does not promise reclaimed file bytes.

acceptance_scenarios.name: unsupported filesystem or observation
acceptance_scenarios.given: Network/non-NTFS root, unsupported attributes, directory leaf, incomplete identity or unavailable allocation.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Refuse unsupported identity/execution cases. Unavailable allocation remains null; allocation unavailability does not fabricate zero or reclaimed bytes.

acceptance_scenarios.name: new admission and outstanding ordinary writes
acceptance_scenarios.given: Compile/LINK/cache/parent creation or failure cleanup remains admitted; new work tries to enter while preview/clean owns gateway.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: No incomplete transfer; deny admission throughout interval. Account every effect and original error; tool exit does not complete cache/namespace writes.

acceptance_scenarios.name: root callback child and service boundaries
acceptance_scenarios.given: Root returns or callbacks drain while descendant, private/shared service, WMI or non-descendant effects remain unaccounted.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Refuse unqualified native completion. Conditional Job/member boundary covers only its scope; root-only defaults, caller flags, /Z7 and service PID snapshots are not proof.

acceptance_scenarios.name: old builder external bypass
acceptance_scenarios.given: Older MQB, lower-level API or outside process can reach the boundary without participation.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Refuse until demonstrated isolation/participant boundary excludes its effects. Upgrading binary or cleaner-only marker is insufficient.

acceptance_scenarios.name: running product launch race
acceptance_scenarios.given: Foreground launch, debugger, loaded/mapped EXE or unknown active use intersects clean; a launch races preview/execute.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Block new participating launches and refuse active/unknown use. Initial profile does not run the EXE; disposition is no mapping bypass.

acceptance_scenarios.name: abandoned writer unresolved marker
acceptance_scenarios.given: Owner dies, started marker remains, drain uncertain or an old incomplete operation is found.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Retain unresolved state and original evidence. No marker reset/removal, age takeover, PID proof, automatic recovery or old-plan authority; new epoch needs qualified release.

acceptance_scenarios.name: pin release delete-rights upgrade gap
acceptance_scenarios.given: Execute would drop read pins and reopen by path or cannot continuously hold compatible deletion authority.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: No mutation; refuse or restart full preview under newly proved authority and fresh consent. Reopened pathname is not the original object.

acceptance_scenarios.name: sharing access deletion state
acceptance_scenarios.given: Held leaf cannot meet qualified delete access/sharing/attributes/state, including uncertain delete-pending state.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Preserve native refusal/error. No attribute-only downgrade, forced flags, POSIX/replacement/mapping bypass or path fallback. Unknown pending state is not absence.

acceptance_scenarios.name: disposition request failure
acceptance_scenarios.given: First requested same-held-leaf disposition fails.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Record failed and native first error/identity; stop further mutations and mark any remaining entries not_attempted. No planned-byte credit.

acceptance_scenarios.name: accepted disposition uncertain close postcondition
acceptance_scenarios.given: Disposition accepted but verified close or exact unchanged-parent name absence is unavailable.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Keep delete_requested plus failed/outcome_unknown stage as applicable. No closed_name_absent/reclaimed-allocation claim, pathname retry or fictional rollback.

acceptance_scenarios.name: record failure interruption partial outcome
acceptance_scenarios.given: Recording unavailable before first mutation, fails after a request, or process interruption/power loss obscures final result.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Acquire recording ability before mutation or refuse. Stop further mutations on failure, expose known outcomes via surviving channels and preserve unresolved evidence. No original-log deletion, cross-file atomicity, durable rollback/recovery or later-session old-plan authority.

acceptance_scenarios.name: subsequent rebuild retained targets
acceptance_scenarios.given: After future independently qualified EXE removal, selected target rebuilds with retained caches; other targets and retained roles are examined.
acceptance_scenarios.required_outcome: Qualify actual missing_output reconstruction under available tools/inputs and retained-target freshness/behavior. Preserve cache warning semantics; do not delete caches to force result or treat source assertions as executed clean/rebuild. This slice runs neither.

eligibility_audit.statement: PR255 接手要求是显式 clean 的资格/拒绝契约及有依据的正向路径；普通 generation 消费者与成本路线已 DEFER，PR250 与 #248 各自 Draft/HOLD，VERSION 5.6.0 不变。贡献规则要求类型化 ownership、.mqb writable state、identity/ownership ambiguous 时 fail closed。

ProjectArtifactLayout.create 形成 project/.mqb；for_source 按源码身份给出 obj/deps/scan/ifc/compile-cache 路径，未带 target/configuration；for_target 仅 target_name+TargetKind，最终 EXE/DLL/LIB 路径没有 configuration 或 architecture 分区。EXE 与 DLL 同名还共用 link-cache 路径。Artifact 的 kind 是显式枚举，并无 PDB/ILK kind；不能按后缀提升现存文件为 typed owner。

StorageCommand 接受 project/format 后 scan_storage+associate_storage_references+report，没有配置加载、目标选择或 clean。旧 Link/Archive cache 解码只取得 output/objects/libraries/file_inputs/side_outputs 等历史引用，保留不透明 signature；常规目录中的 regular file 被移出 protected 分类不等于取得 ownership，文档仍规定 reclaimable/live/obsolete 为 null、deletion=false。

ArtifactStorageAssociation 按给定词法键做纯 join，拥有输入副本；relative path 必须有记录的 absolute cwd，NUL/..、root-relative/drive-relative 不能猜基准。同键多行保持 ambiguous；唯一 regular path 匹配后只列观察到同 physical_id 的 aliases，元数据冲突不消失。not_observed 不是磁盘不存在，input/declared_output/metadata_reference 角色互不升级，identity/current_contents/deletion 均 false。Windows scan 观察期间 pin 祖先/叶子并读取 NumberOfLinks/file ID，但结果不继续持有这些叶子句柄。

当前 RecordedTargetResult 含 TargetCompileCacheEvidence；CompileCacheEvidence.exact_cache_entry_captured=true，保存最终成功 wave 的同次 accepted/sealed cache。不能沿用旧结论说普通目标没有 exact cache。其 producer_identity/current_content/complete_producer_inventory/deletion 仍 false；旧 SourceArtifactAssociation 的 deps/cache 字段仍只是引用。严格 projection 检查源顺序、request/cache shape、outcome、options，但不是对当前文件系统的验证。

MsvcCompileRecipe 有 toolchain、typed invocation 与 ProcessSpec；普通 compile object、可选 IFC/dependencies 与 HU invocation 独立建模。默认 Debug 和 Release compiler 都用 /Z7；raw 参数之后追加 typed runtime/LTCG/PCH/output 路由，CL/_CL_ ambient 参数被移除。编译器 /Zi、/ZI 被拒绝，/Fd 等由 MQB 拥有；这与 LINK PDB 是两类产物。

现有 LinkInvocation/MsvcLinkRecipe 能表达最终 objects/libraries/output/options/cwd/force_full_link/observation/process；LINK 参数工厂按顺序应用 defaults、raw options、最终 typed output，再抑制 LINK/_LINK_/LINK_REPRO。LinkArtifactRecord 仅保留 entry/options/cache/cwd，未保留实际终端 recipe。prewrite collect 明言候选配方早于 default-library routing 与 late freshness，不是 final argv。MsvcLinker.link 对 exit 0 返回成功，coordinator 成功边界封存路径与 side observations，并没有给主 EXE 建立当前物理/内容收据。

LINK PDB 的路径由 program_database_path 派生，启用依据 configuration 后依序处理 /DEBUG、/DEBUG:FULL、/DEBUG:FASTLINK、/DEBUG:NONE；Debug 可禁用，Release 可显式启用。最终 /PDB 路径由 linker authority 追加。coordinator 仅在有效且存在时收为 side output，MAP 则显式请求后必须 regular。即使收录，也只有历史路径并无当前 ownership。

现有 Debug 链接可发 /INCREMENTAL；Release 发 /INCREMENTAL:NO，force_full_link 或 MAP 在 raw flags 之后强制 NO。参数 registry 将 /ILK: 归 MQB-owned，但当前 write inventory 仍明确把 .ilk/LTCG/object directives 放在 native_gap；成功 LinkCacheEntry.side_outputs 的收集没有 ILK。不能因扩展名或 /INCREMENTAL 就造出 ILK producer receipt。

DLL final、import .lib、.exp 由 linker authority 分开派生；同 stem 的 EXE/DLL 都可指向同 PDB，DLL import .lib 可与静态 final .lib 相同，布局还使同名 EXE/DLL link cache 重叠。LIB 使用独立 ArchiveInvocation/MsvcArchiveRecipe 与 sibling .mqb-tmp；实际实现先验证 temporary regular，再移除旧 final 后 rename，不能将注释中的 atomic 字样当成全事务/跨产物 crash 保证。所有这些都不属于首片 EXE clean。 LIB 的有效配方仍来自既有 route_librarian：校验 objects/output、architecture/LTCG 和允许的 raw options，再产生 transaction argv 与 toolchain/cwd/environment；这不是另建以文件后缀推测产物的模型。

PCH layout 按 target/config/arch 派生 creator.cpp/obj/deps/project.pch/cache；PCH use/create 角色有别。普通 target 的 additional objects 是上游 input，prewrite 必须由其 producer 另供 creator/metadata/cache writes。模块工厂为普通 source 产 obj、接口 source 产 obj+IFC，HU factory 只声明 IFC；低层 HU invocation 可显式带 optional object，不能一概猜 paired object。external module providers 是 read-only；scan projection 不把 P1689 declarations 提升为产物，deps/cache 与 scan 都保留 metadata_reference。

LinkCacheValidator 在有/无 cached entry 时均对缺失主 output 给 missing_output；无需先删除 link cache 来使缺失 EXE 不再被当成命中。普通 target 成功路径把同次 compile outputs 作为 final LINK inputs。该源码分支说明后续重建会走现有缺失输出判断，不是本轮运行证明，也不保证未来输入/工具变化后重建成功或逐字节相同。

已读取的测试文本明确覆盖：同路径配置改变、absent conditional PDB 不伪造、reused 非新 generation、cache save failure 不称 durable、LINK/MAP failure 不返回成功记录；association 测试保留共享/重复引用、hard-link alias、同路径 replacement 的观察性质和 false authority。这里只报告测试源码所断言的契约，未运行它们，也没有声称 native/clean 验收通过。

write-domain 文档明确：begin_writes 后没有 completion/reset/recovery，marker 只序列化合作且选相同 authority directory 的客户端；native inventory 仍保留 unresolved effects，leaf observations 是有限观察，不是 reservation/ready。PR255 接手再次限定 cleaner-only marker 不能排除旧 builders、scope exit 不证明 writers stopped。本报告不将该基础提升为可用 clean gateway。

writer_audit.statement: open 要求现有绝对目录、local NTFS、volume-GUID，并保留目录 HANDLE。try_reserve 在该 HANDLE 下以 NtCreateFile(FILE_CREATE) 独占创建固定 marker、写入诊断 unresolved 并 flush；任何已有/不可判定 marker 都拒绝。begin_writes 只检查 phase==reserved，再置 writing；不检查 known writes、缺口、producer/工具或子进程。withdraw_unstarted 仅 reserved，writing 明确拒绝；destructor/move replacement 只关闭句柄，既不删除 marker，也没有 complete/reset/recovery 方法。

WriteInventory 是 additive evidence，cache owner 增加真实 cache filename 与 immediate replacement namespace。每个 native recipe 永远保留 native effects gap；ordinary aggregate 保留 upstream、source-order typed errors、PCH/additional-object gap 和 late LINK routing/freshness gap。空 unresolved 不是许可。WindowsWriteInventory 仅固定 exact physical parents；缺父目录不创建也不上溯；叶子以 FILE_OPEN 观察后释放，多个 hard links/reparse/directory/delete-pending 拒绝。

cpp/src+cpp/include 的定向 callsite 搜索对 collect_prewrite_inventory/run_with_compile_admission_stop/try_reserve/begin_writes 只返回 declaration 与 definition；没有生产调用。Application 执行 SourceDiscovery::discover、locator.discover、PCH/ordinary/module/static 分支，ordinary 调 target_coordinator.run，均未持有 write-domain lease。计划/compdb 不因 inventory API 的存在获得写入授权。外部 C++ 客户可显式 opt in，并不改变当前仓库 CLI 事实。

ProcessSpec 默认 token 为 root-only；仅 stop_possible 创建 creation-time unnamed non-inheritable Job、无 breakaway，并要求 retained verified member handles signaled、TotalProcesses 不变、ActiveProcesses==0 后返回。Job 不覆盖 service/WMI/non-descendant，error/job-close/owner death 都不授予 lease transfer。run_with_compile_admission_stop 是 callback natural drain，不向 ProcessSpec 传 token；LINK 终阶段一次准入后晚到 stop 不回滚。WorkBatch::all_succeeded 不是 external writer completion。

compile prepare_parent 在调用工具前创建目录，compile executor 检查输出和 sourceDependencies 后 coordinator 才 seal/save cache；LINK 后也有 side-output 收集、cache save。两种 cache save 都执行 temporary file/flush/remove old/rename，save_failed 可作为 warning 与成功产物一起返回。LIB 还会删除 temporary、删除旧 archive 并 rename。单个 root exit 或 result.linked/compiled 不覆盖这些写入，更不提供跨文件 atomic transaction。

当前公开参数边界 Debug/Release 使用 /Z7、拒绝 /Zi /ZI、保留 /Fd 所有权，且编译调用移除 CL/_CL_。这些不是完整 native effect closure：低层 recipe test 明确接受 /Zi /Fd raw recipe 后仅保留 gap，外部对象/PCH/IFC 也不被该 CLI 边界覆盖。LINK 可独立输出最终 PDB。微软 /FS 文档说明写经 MSPDBSRV 序列化且不消除全部并行错误；它不提供每次 invocation 的停写/后续请求栅栏。默认服务存在或消失，均不能代替选定输出的 completion authority。

build scope 结束后创建独立 foreground runner；BuildCompletion 只有 owned optional ProcessSpec，默认无 stoppable token，guard 拒绝继承 build cancellation。无 executable physical pin、current generation check 或 target-use lease。因此 --run/后来手工运行、DLL loader/debugger/PDB reader 生命周期不能从 C++ scope exit 推导完成。

StorageReadPrimitives::pin 用 FILE_READ_DATA|FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES + FILE_SHARE_READ，拒绝某些读写/删除 share 冲突而不降级 attribute-only。StorageFileObservation 在规范化前拒绝 .. 等语法，持有无 reparse 祖先/叶子，读取 identity/bytes/links，返回立即 RAII 释放；hard_links>1 仍可 observed。返回值四个 authority 常量全 false。PathIdentity 是 casing/lexical cache key，不能替代 held volume/file ID 或物理 parent chain。file ID 能比较两个打开句柄，不是跨删除重建永久身份，也不证明内容或 producer。

已读定义涵盖 alias retarget、owner-dead child still writes、unresolved marker 保留、hard-link ambiguity、no-tool collection、观察返回释放 handles、post-build/pre-open gap、cache warning 保留。静态 isolation/file tests 自述不是 native/performance proof，并固定旧边界。本轮未执行、导入或改动任何这些测试；不把已读断言报为新的 Windows/MSVC 验证。
